verdict.rationale: Logseq has its own plugin API surface (logseq.App, Editor, DB, UI and other namespaces) documented at plugins-doc.logseq.com, and it supports loading self-built unpacked plugins and distributing them through a Marketplace. However, that documentation describes itself as community-driven rather than first-party, and the pack contains no plugin samples, SDK package or getting-started guide; the only worked examples are curl calls to the local HTTP API. Missing for 10: sample/starter plugins, an official first-party SDK and developer guide (setup, build, publish), and hands-on corroboration of plugin development.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build my own plugins against a documented extension API/SDK with samples and developer docs

citations.quote: This is a community-driven documentation for Logseq plugin APIs.
